# SMSM.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp2,649.0 against Rp1,620.0 (expected total return 73.0%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: derated_compounder_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Autos, components & dealerships.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The base and bear working-capital ratios are set below the last actual. The pack latest_bs carries operating working capital of Rp2,477.6bn at 30 September 2026, which is 43.1% of FY2026E revenue, against the Rp2,212.7bn
- The terminal value pays for an incremental return that is never stated. In FY2035E the model reinvests Rp124.3bn (net capex is zero, the whole amount is the working-capital build) against NOPAT of Rp1,925.5bn, 6.5% of NO
- The cost of capital cannot be reproduced from the inputs section 4 states. Risk-free 7.45% plus levered beta 0.91 times the sum of ERP 4.23% and CRP 2.46% is 13.54%, outside the house 11-13% band, yet the model uses 11.9

**Regime AGAINST (set 2026-11-11 IDEATION).** Autos/components sit in the desk AVOID. Variant that beats it: SMSM sells filters largely on USD export contracts with an IDR cost base, so IDR weakness lifts margin and the domestic funding leg is not the driver.
